$schema_note: The five motion-state poses. Rotation-only: every value is a rotation in DEGREES about the joint hinge axis [1,0,0]; nothing translates except the documented root_offset_m, which is engine-driven root motion (jump height / squat depth), not articulation.
how_to_apply: local_deg is the local rotation of each articulation node relative to its parent - apply these to the nodes named in golem_physics.json. world_deg is the same pose expressed as absolute world-space orientation (what the Maya captures used); for this all-parallel-X rig, world = sum of locals down the chain. The extend pose adds a Z-axis abduction on the arm chain: [rx, 0, rz], with rz mirrored (L negative shown; negate rz for the R side). All other values are L/R symmetric.
sign_convention: positive rotates the segment's lower end backward (-Z). Hip flexion (leg forward) is negative, knee flexion positive, torso forward pitch positive.

rest.note: Exactly the delivered file, untouched. The 35-40 deg knee coil and silverback arm hang are authored into the geometry.

extend.note: shin -38 = the knee's own range edge; legs are anatomically straight. Arm locals about non-parallel axes are approximate - the authoritative arm values are the world_deg triples; mirror rz for the right side.

absorb.fires_on: landing; engine scales depth by impact speed
absorb.note: shin at 52 = deepest knee compression the range allows. This is the full-speed landing; scale locals toward rest for softer impacts.
